_comment: Biaxial load cell calibration config for NI cDAQ-9174 + NI-9219 (Extracted from NI MAX configData.nce - Task 'German and chinese lc cali').

_units.sensitivity_vv: V/V (Volts per Volt at full excitation)
_units.intercept_n: Newtons — physical value at 0 V/V output (first_physical_val)
_units.span_n: Newtons — physical value at sensitivity_vv output (second_physical_val)
_units.sample_rate_hz: Samples per second (hardware max for NI-9219: 100 S/s aggregate)
